title: Influence of Mild Therapeutic Hypothermia on Leukocyte Count
brief_summary: Mild therapeutic hypothermia is indicated in patients surviving out-of-hospital cardiac arrest due to ventricular fibrillation. Potential immunologic responses are unknown.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Survivors of cardiac arrest due to VF
* Age 18-90

Exclusion Criteria:

* Suspected / proven pregnancy
* Immunodeficiency
study_population: Survivors in out of hospital cardiac arrest
